gap: Can measured-increment recursive least squares identify the existing acceleration readout quickly without any pretrained feature map?
initialization: Two fresh OnlineFit(prefix) constructions per case using original begin:first inclusive states and begin:first commands only; require exact parameter/normalizer equality. No saved model/session loads, offline training, fleet priors or reused learned state. Identical seed0 generic features, prefix-only two ridge solves. Record actual prefix bounds, sample counts, tape time of first prediction and synchronized construction/first-prediction/first-update latency. Prefix availability is not free: original quad begin50 first125 means scoring starts1.25s after release, using75 transitions from0.5s onward; fixedwing begin0 first15 means0.75s. Not an immediate throw-recovery trial.

arms.baseline: Unchanged public OnlineFit, one full-model 16-PCG update per observation.
arms.candidate: Freeze feature weights, filters, accumulators and all normalizers at identical fresh prefix initialization; update linear/quadratic/bias/w2 only. Readout phi=[full normalized sampled features, normalized current quadratic features,1,tanh(compact normalized features@w1+b1)]. Preserve every output path:381features/2286weights forU4,D10. Prior mean is the prefix readout; precision is ridge*I with ridge=0.01*initialized_transition_count, matching the initializer ridge magnitude. No prefix samples assimilated again. Float64 RLS: p=P@phi, gain=p/(1+phi@p), M+=outer(gain,y-phi@M), P-=outer(p,p)/(1+phi@p), symmetrize. No forgetting, damping search, parameter clipping, extra feature fitting, adaptive normalization or rollout acceptance guard in this first screen. Report invalid numerical behavior; no calibrated covariance claim.
arms.frozen: Prediction-only copy of initial model as an unchanged-prefix diagnostic; no extra fitting.

measurement: After observing next state, reconstruct incoming filtered command/history/hidden state with existing _history on real context. Evaluate features at measured interval midpoint: average world velocities and body rates; Rmid=Rstart@exp(dt/4*(omega_start+omega_end)); filtered_mid=u+(incoming_filtered-u)*exp(-dt/(2*tau)); incoming lag history and hidden fixed across interval. Target=[Rmid.T@((v_next-v_start)/dt-gravity),(omega_next-omega_start)/dt]/output_scale. This is midpoint quadrature of measured increments; no measured accelerometer or simulator acceleration. The frozen feature loss is linear, while forecasts retain the unchanged nonlinear physical integrator. Noise/errors-in-variables and quadrature bias are unqualified.

evaluation.causality: Save each one-step prediction before revealing its next observation. Call observe exactly once per revealed transition. Only runner/scorer accesses the full sealed tape. Reset every case. Save initial/final parameters, all targets, predictions, times and work counts.
evaluation.conditional_forecasts: At offsets0,16,32,48, predict up to250ms with actual subsequent command tape for retrospective conditional scoring, using only current model weights/history. This is not an online-available future-command plan. Score50ms and250ms when complete truth/commands exist. No counterfactual response or controller success claim.
evaluation.metrics: Physical velocity-vector and body-rate-vector RMSE, orientation geodesic RMSE; per-case, first16/rest, equal-case within family then equal-family geometric candidate/baseline ratios, denominator floor1e-9. Report frozen comparison. Do not treat duplicate quad-change prefix as independent configuration evidence.
evaluation.timing: Single CPU process, no concurrent heavy jobs. Alternate baseline/candidate update order each row, synchronize both; measure complete observe plus model snapshot. Record first-use compilation separately and all latencies; warmed median/p95 exclude first update only. Include covariance setup in candidate initialization. Record cumulative prediction+update+initialization compute curves and source-observation time separately; no live scheduler or hardware claim.
evaluation.stop: Finish bounded roster unless nonfinite model/forecast, exception, or600s wall budget; preserve partial results and stop the experiment on such failure. No broad offline fits, derivative campaign or simulator reruns for a clear loss.
evaluation.decision: Diagnostic promising region: equal-family median update ratio<=0.5, one-step primary<=1.15,250ms primary<=1.25, each-family primary<=1.5, all finite. These guide overall judgement rather than single-cell vetoes. A substantial consistent accuracy loss ends this fixed-feature/measurement candidate; do not rescue it with pretraining. Promising evidence warrants a separately frozen longer causal/response comparison, not automatic adoption.

verification: Commit protocol before implementation and scientific code before runs. Analytic readout reconstruction, RLS vs independent batch ridge, and unchanged frozen feature arrays. Authenticate tapes and saved results; recompute physical scores and chronology from arrays without fitting. Current package remains unchanged during this diagnostic.
